test_title: PYST 4: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

The committee **have submitted its final report.**
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. has submitted its final report .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the sentence is **"The committee"**, which is a collective noun.
 
• Collective nouns are usually treated as singular when referring to the group as a whole and require singular verbs.
 
• Therefore, the verb **"has submitted"** is correct, as it agrees with the singular subject.

Correct sentence: *The committee has submitted its final report*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Verb Agreement with Collective Nouns:**

 
 
• When the collective noun refers to the group as a single entity, use singular verbs.
 
• Example: The team *is* ready to play.
 
• When the collective noun refers to individuals within the group, use plural verbs.
 
• Example: The committee *have* different opinions.
 
 
 
• **Common Errors:**
 
 
• Using plural verbs incorrectly with singular collective nouns can lead to grammatical mistakes.
 
• Example: Incorrect: The committee *have submitted* its report.
